Icy Wind (Japanese: こごえるかぜ Chilling Wind) is a damage-dealing Ice-type move introduced in Generation II.

It is:

  • TM16 in Generation II.
  • TM27 in Pokémon Sword and Shield.
  • TM034 in Generation IX.

Effect

Generation II

Icy Wind inflicts damage and has a 99.6% chance of lowering the target's Speed stat by one stage.

Generation III onwards

Icy Wind deals damage to all adjacent opponents and lowers the Speed of hit Pokémon by one stage.

Icy Wind can be used as part of a Contest Spectacular combination, with the user gaining extra three appeal points if the move Hail was used in the prior turn.

In other games

Pokémon Mystery Dungeon series

In Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team, Icy Wind is a move with 5 power, 84% accuracy and 13 PP. The attack travels up to 10 tiles away and hits the first Pokémon it encounters, ally or enemy, lowering its Movement Speed by one level.

In Explorers of Time, Darkness and Sky, the move's accuracy has been decreased to 79.8%.

Pokémon UNITE

In Pokémon UNITE, Icy Wind is Alolan Ninetales's second move. The user attacks with a gust of freezing air, damaging, shoving, and slowing enemies hit. At level 6, it is replaced by either Blizzard or Aurora Veil.

Description

Games Description
MDRB Inflicts damage on the target, even at a distance. It also lowers the target's Movement Speed by one level.
MDTDS Inflicts damage on the target, even at a distance. It also reduces the target's Movement Speed by 1 level.

Conq. Blow an icy gale toward the target. May also reduce the target's Range.

SMD It damages a Pokémon, even one far away. It also lowers the Pokémon's Travel Speed.
MDRTDX It damages a Pokémon, even one far away. It also lowers the target's Travel Speed.
